requirements.title: Number LA local alternate cardinality
requirements.atomic_statement: A Number=LA FORMAT value has one element for each alternate allele selected by LAA, excluding REF.
requirements.condition: A FORMAT field declares Number=LA.

requirements.observable_acceptance_condition: The value count equals the number of ALT indices in the applicable LAA vector.
